description: This source file defines the 'OfbizPathShortener' class, which provides utility methods for creating, resolving, and restoring shortened URL paths within the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes functionalities such as generating unique short paths, mapping them to original paths, and retrieving the original paths from shortened versions.

classes.name: OfbizPathShortener
classes.description: Utility class providing static methods to handle URL shortening and resolution within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: shortenPath
methods.description: Returns a shortened URL path linked to the provided original path.

methods.name: resolveShortenedPath
methods.description: Checks if a shortened path exists for the given path; if not, generates a new shortened path.

methods.name: restoreOriginalPath
methods.description: Resolves a shortened path back to its original URL, defaulting to the web app root if not found.

methods.name: resolveOriginalPathFromShortened
methods.description: Retrieves the original URL associated with a given shortened path.

methods.name: resolveExistingShortenedPath
methods.description: Attempts to find an existing shortened path for the original URL based on its hash.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Generates a random string of a configurable length to be used as a shortened path.

methods.name: recordPathMapping
methods.description: Creates a mapping in the database between an original URL and its shortened version within a transaction.

methods.name: generateHash
methods.description: Produces a hash of the original path used for lookup optimization.

methods.name: readPathMapping
methods.description: Fetches the mapping from the database for a given shortened path.
